name: Command Palette — Neo-Brutalism
description: Brutalist Cmd+K command palette overlay with hard black borders, offset drop shadows, and flat bright accents. Live search filters grouped commands, arrow keys move the highlight, Enter runs the selected command with a confirmation toast, Escape closes, and Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles open. Focus is trapped inside the palette and restored to the trigger on close.
features: hard offset shadows and bright flat accents
live search filtering across grouped commands
Enter runs command with confirmation toast
focus trap while open, focus restore on close
role dialog and role option with aria-selected
